-- What a client importing `Spec.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.StartNode` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def StartNode.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk)
    (hs : HardStateM) (csm : ConfStateM) (Q : IProp GF) (peers : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (pv : List Peer),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        HsEmpty hs →
                          csm.Voters' = [] →
                            csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                              csm.Learners' = [] →
                                csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                  csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                    vs = List.map Peer.ID' pv →
                                      ⊢
                                        ∀ Φ,
                                          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                              typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                isLogger lok ∗
                                                  bootStorage γ cv.ID' (GoInterface.ok si) hs csm Q ∗
                                                    ownSlice peers pv dq ∗
                                                      peersCtx pv ctxs ∗ nodeBoot γ N vs ctxs cv.ID' -∗
                                            (▷
                                                ∀ nd,
                                                  (∃ n,
                                                      ⌜nd = interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                        isNode n γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                          nodeDriver n γ N (NodeDriverState.init (GoInterface.ok si)) ∗
                                                            nodeConfig n γ N
                                                                { applied := 0,
                                                                  membership := Membership.simple (listToSet vs) } ∗
                                                              nodeRunning n γ N 1 ∗ Q ∗ ownSlice peers pv dq) -∗
                                                    Φ (intoVal nd)) -∗
                                              WP (((intoVal (functions StartNode [])) (intoVal c)) (intoVal peers))
                                                {{ Φ }}
